title: 第7章 血色孔明灯第8章 我带你出去
slug: 无敌的女厉鬼有点恋爱脑
lines: 陆远穿越来此方世界一年，遭遇过的最强邪祟，是十星。
那是一只缢鬼。
彼时他进深山寻参，差点被那东西活活勒死，若非老头子及时赶到，他早已是林中一具枯骨。
自那以后，陆远看见绳套一类的东西，腿肚子都会下意识绷紧。
那成了他一辈子的阴影。
但要清楚，他这【斩妖除魔】系统所显示的星级，是根据他自身实力浮动的！
随着他道行渐深，当初那只十星缢鬼，如今再看，顶多也就是个六星。
可眼前这只“人面两脚羊”……
八星！
这绝对是陆远目前为止，遇到的最恐怖的邪祟！
况且，人面两脚羊，并非鬼物，而是精怪。
此类邪祟，往往比同道行的鬼物更加凶戾难缠。
八星精怪……
陆远暗自估量，这东西的实力，恐怕已能比肩三星天师！
这赵巧儿到底是在整啥活计嘞！！
连八星的邪祟都整来了……
约莫一个小时后。
王成安领着一行人从山下赶了回来。
为首的是一位头发花白的老者，正是此次的东家。
当东家踉跄着走到坟前，只朝坑里看了一眼，便“噗通”一声跪倒在地，瞬间老泪纵横，哭声嘶哑。
身后的一众孝子贤孙也跟着跪倒一片。
哭嚎声与焚烧纸钱的烟火气混杂在一起，弥漫在冷冽的山风里。
陆远三人静立一旁，眼观鼻，鼻观心，如三尊没有感情的石像。
待一炷香烧尽，哭声渐歇，陆远才上前，与王成安一同将那老东家扶起。
到了结账的时候了。
三人一人十块的辛苦钱。
此外，还有五十块，是给真龙观的香火钱。
老东家付了钱，一双哭得红肿的老眼死死盯着陆远，声音颤抖地问：
“家祖……此后，当真能安宁了吗？”
陆远微微摇头。
在东家一家人陡然煞白的脸色中，他从袖中取出一张折叠好的泛黄符纸，不急不缓地展开。
“尸身虽毁，怨执未散尽。”
陆远的声音不大，却清晰地压过了山风的呼啸。
content_en:
Lu Yuan traveled to this world for a year, and the most powerful evil spirit he encountered was Shixing.
That's a hanged ghost.
At that time, he went into the mountains to look for ginseng and was almost strangled to death by that thing. If the old man hadn't arrived in time, he would have been a withered skeleton in the forest.
From then on, when Lu Yuan saw things like rope nooses, his calves would tighten subconsciously.
That became a lifelong shadow for him.
But it must be clear that the star rating displayed by his [Demon Slayer] system fluctuates according to his own strength!
As his path progressed, the ten-star hanged ghost at the beginning was now only a six-star at best.
But this "goat with a human face and two legs" in front of me...
Eight stars!
This is definitely the most terrifying evil spirit Lu Yuan has encountered so far!
Moreover, the goat with a human face and two legs is not a ghost, but a spirit.
Such evil spirits are often more vicious and difficult to deal with than their fellow ghosts.
Eight-star monster...
Lu Yuan secretly estimated that the strength of this thing might be comparable to that of a three-star heavenly master!
Alas! !
What on earth is Zhao Qiaoer up to? !
Even the evil spirits of the Eight Stars have come...
…
About an hour later.
Wang Chengan led a group of people back from the mountain.
The leader is an old man with gray hair, who is the owner this time.
When the owner staggered to the grave, he only glanced into the pit, and then he knelt down with a "pop", bursting into tears and crying hoarsely.
"Dad!!"
The filial sons and grandsons behind him also knelt down.
The sound of crying was mixed with the smoke of fireworks burning paper money, permeating the cold mountain wind.
Lu Yuan and the others stood aside quietly, looking at their noses with their eyes and their hearts with their noses, like three emotionless stone statues.
After the stick of incense burned out and the crying gradually subsided, Lu Yuan stepped forward and helped his old boss up together with Wang Chengan.
It's time to check out.
Ten yuan of hard-earned money for three people.
In addition, there is fifty yuan, which is the incense money for the True Dragon Temple.
"Taoist Priest..."
The old boss paid the money, stared at Lu Yuan with a pair of old eyes red and swollen from crying, and asked in a trembling voice:
"My ancestor... will he really be able to live in peace from now on?"
Lu Yuan shook his head slightly.
When the faces of the host family suddenly turned pale, he took out a folded yellowed talisman paper from his sleeve and unfolded it unhurriedly.
"Although the body is destroyed, the resentment and resentment are not dissipated."
Lu Yuan's voice was not loud, but it was clearly heard over the howling of the mountain wind.
